registration.summary: Mandatory for every Leave & License agreement, regardless of duration — including 11-month terms.
registration.nonRegistrationRisk: Non-registration risks inadmissibility as evidence and a fine up to ₹5,000.

stampDuty.formula: 0.25% of total rent over the license period + 0.25% of a notional 10% p.a. interest on the refundable deposit

policeVerification.note: Online verification is available via the Maharashtra Police citizen portal.
